python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# National Defense expenditures (in millions)
expenditures = [680, 531, 689, 900, 929, 1029, 1206, 1657, 6301]

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates: ln(E[t] / E[t-1])
log_growth_rates = []
for i in range(1, len(expenditures)):
    rate = math.log(expenditures[i] / expenditures[i-1])
    log_growth_rates.append(rate)
    print(f"Log growth rate {expenditures[i-1]}->{expenditures[i]}: {rate:.6f}")

# Calculate mean of log growth rates
n = len(log_growth_rates)
mean = sum(log_growth_rates) / n
print(f"\nMean of log growth rates: {mean:.6f}")

# Calculate population standard deviation
variance = sum((r - mean) ** 2 for r in log_growth_rates) / n
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Population standard deviation: {std_dev:.6f}")

# Coefficient of variation = std_dev / mean
cv = std_dev / mean
print(f"\nCoefficient of variation: {cv:.4f}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredth: {cv:.2f}")
EOF

n = len(log_growth_rates)
mean = sum(log_growth_rates) / n

# Calculate population standard deviation (divide by n, not n-1)
variance = sum((r - mean) ** 2 for r in log_growth_rates) / n
